ios.desc:
Can't sleep because your mind won't stop racing?
NightClear is not another meditation app. It's a structured toolkit that stops the mental loops keeping you up — and catches you when panic strikes. Using AI, CBT-inspired techniques, and clinically-backed grounding tools, NightClear helps you go from spiraling to sleeping in minutes.

——— NEW: INSTANT CALM TOOLKIT ———

QUICK CALM — SOS FOR PANIC MOMENTS
Feeling overwhelmed right now? Tap the SOS button, pick what you're feeling, and get an instant comfort message with a recommended grounding tool. No sign-up. No paywall. Just help, right now.

GROUNDING TOOLKIT — 5 PHYSICAL TOOLS
When your body is in fight-or-flight, thinking won't help. Physical action will.
• Ice Hold — Grip something cold for 60 seconds. The shock resets your nervous system.
• Slow Breathing — 3 guided patterns (Slow, Box, 4-7-8) with visual pacers.
• Warm Comfort — Place warmth on your body and let your muscles unclench.
• Body Scan — Move through 6 body regions, releasing tension one area at a time.
• 5-4-3-2-1 Senses — Reconnect with reality through your five senses.
All grounding tools are completely free with unlimited use.

——— CORE: 5-MINUTE CLEAR ———

HOW IT WORKS
1. DUMP YOUR THOUGHTS
Type what's on your mind. No judgment, no one else will see it. Just let it all out.
2. AI ANALYSIS
Our AI breaks down your anxiety: What's really bothering you? What can you control? What's outside your control?
3. ONE SMALL STEP
Get a personalized "Micro-Action" for tomorrow — concrete, doable in 5 minutes, no overwhelm.
4. BREATHE & CLOSE
End with a guided breathing exercise and see your anxiety score drop. Close the day with intention.

KEY FEATURES
• AI-Powered Analysis — Instantly understand the root cause and structure of your stress
• Night Anxiety Index (NAI) — Track your mental load with a professional anxiety score
• Micro-Actions — One actionable step per session, designed to create forward momentum
• Trends & Insights — Visualize your anxiety patterns, grounding tool usage, and progress over time
• Privacy First — Your thoughts stay on your device
• Dark Mode Only — Designed for bedtime, easy on your eyes
• Session History — Review all past sessions with full details

DESIGNED FOR NIGHT — AND FOR RIGHT NOW
NightClear is intentionally minimal. No social features. No gamification. No endless content. Just a 5-minute ritual to clear your mind before sleep — and a panic button for when anxiety can't wait until bedtime.
Stop scrolling. Stop

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built NightClear because during the day I'm productive. At night, my brain becomes a worst-case-scenario simulator.

Based on CBT's "structured worry time" — instead of suppressing anxious thoughts, you give them a container:

1. Type what's on your mind (free-form, private)
2. LLM analyzes: core issue, controllable vs not
3. Generates one micro-action for tomorrow
4. Breathing exercise

SwiftUI, SwiftData (local), LLM API. Dark mode only. No account needed. No social/gamification.

Free: 3/week. Pro: $4.99/mo or $29.99/yr (7-day trial).

iOS only. Would love feedback on the AI analysis quality.
